output: P(dead_v2) where dead_v2 = no trade in [launch+1h, launch+2h] OR price at launch+2h <= 0.1 x price at first sight
valid_for: pump.fun bonding-curve coins (SOL-quoted, NOT mayhem), coin age 2-32 min, at least 1 trade seen. Mayhem coins and graduated (PumpSwap) pools are out of distribution: route them to rules.

conventions.missing: send null; the trees route it (never impute 0 unless the spec says so)
conventions.SOL: amounts in SOL, not USD: divide Gecko USD volume by the SOL/USD price (Gecko token price of SOL, or Jupiter)
conventions.p_init: 2.7958993476e-8 SOL per token (pump.fun curve start: 30 SOL virtual / 1.073e9 virtual tokens)
conventions.age: seconds since the mint's create tx (Gecko pool_created_at for a curve pool)

age_min.def: coin age in minutes at decision time (train range 2-32)

ret_since_launch.source: Gecko attributes.base_token_price_native_currency, or bonding-curve account virtual reserves (RPC getAccountInfo): price = v_sol/v_tok

p_max_ratio.def: ln(max trade price since launch / p_init)
p_max_ratio.source: Gecko OHLCV /pools/{pool}/ohlcv/minute?aggregate=1 (max high), or own snapshots

sell_ratio.def: sells/(buys+sells) since launch; null if 0 trades

top1.def: largest wallet balance / total supply (1e9), bonding-curve account EXCLUDED, dev INCLUDED
top1.source: RPC getTokenLargestAccounts(mint), drop the curve's associated token account

top5.def: sum of top-5 wallet balances / supply (curve excluded)

dev_share_now.def: creator wallet balance / supply; null if creator unknown
dev_share_now.source: creator = fee payer of the mint's create tx (getSignaturesForAddress(mint, before=oldest) + getTransaction, or curve account .creator field); balance via getTokenAccountsByOwner(creator, {mint})

dev_buy_pct.def: creator's first (create-tx) buy as % of supply (0-100)
dev_buy_pct.source: token balance change in the create tx

initial_buy_sol.def: SOL the creator spent in the create tx buy

cr_prior_launches.def: log1p(# pump.fun launches by this creator strictly before now)
cr_prior_launches.source: creator index (see live design: weekly loopholetape CC-BY dump + own crawler)

cr_launches_24h.def: log1p(# launches by this creator in the last 24h, excluding this one)

cr_gap_s.def: log1p(seconds since the creator's previous launch); null if first

cr_first_launch.def: 1 if no prior launch by creator else 0

cr_dead_rate.def: share of the creator's prior launches already resolved (>=2h old) that were dead_v2; null if none resolved
cr_dead_rate.source: creator index + FlagKan outcomes / loopholetape rugged flag as proxy

parity: each model JSON embeds 25 input vectors with expected outputs; `node out/predict-live.mjs out/model-live.json` must print OK
